annotations.title: Request a now check (is it still true right now?)

description: Request that a human verifies whether a fact is true at this moment (open now, in stock, price, event happening) and timestamps the answer with evidence. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 9 by phone or web, EUR 39 on site in the pilot region. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

claim.description: The statement to check, e.g. 'Café X at Y is open today until 18:00'.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

deadline.description: Optional: by when you need the answer.

location.description: Optional: address or place if relevant.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
